# Supported target and feature matrix

| Target | Triple | Status | Features | Artifact | Required evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| x86_64 QEMU/OVMF | `x86_64-unknown-none` | supported | `x86_64_deps; kernel cloud-profile+x86_64_arch` | release ISO and disk image | build, strict lint, host suites, signed boot, unsigned negative boot, SMP QEMU |
| Raspberry Pi 5 | `aarch64-unknown-none` | supported after HIL | `aarch64_deps; kernel embedded-rpi5` | raw AArch64 kernel plus root filesystem | build, strict lint, signing policy, physical boot, GPIO/control/timer/storage/failsafe HIL |
| AArch64 virt | `aarch64-unknown-none` | experimental | `kernel cloud-profile+virt` | kernel check only | compile check; no production compatibility claim |
| RISC-V demo | `riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf` | experimental standalone | `standalone manifest` | demo binary outside the axiomos release | target lint and build only |
| Shrike RP2040 firmware | `thumbv6m-none-eabi` | supported after HIL | `cloud-profile or embedded-profile` | standalone firmware image | target lint/build, mock-HAL tests, physical control-link/watchdog/failsafe HIL |
